import numpy as np import matplotlib as mpl import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
INK = "#263238" BLUE = "#33658A" TEAL = "#2A9D8F" SLATE = "#657786"
mpl.rcParams.update({ "font.family": "DejaVu Sans", "font.size": 10, "mathtext.fontset": "dejavusans", "figure.facecolor": "white", "axes.facecolor": "white", "axes.edgecolor": INK, "axes.labelcolor": INK, "text.color": INK, "xtick.color": SLATE, "ytick.color": SLATE, "axes.spines.top": False, "axes.spines.right": False, "axes.linewidth": 0.8, "xtick.major.width": 0.8, "ytick.major.width": 0.8, "svg.fonttype": "none", })
n = np.arange(4) x = np.array([4, 2, 0, 2]) u0 = np.array([1, 1, 1, 1]) u1 = np.array([1, 0, -1, 0])
if not np.array_equal(x, 2 * u0 + 2 * u1): raise ValueError("The supplied pattern vectors do not reconstruct the signal.")
fig = plt.figure(figsize=(9.8, 4.2), dpi=100) positions = [ [0.070, 0.300, 0.235, 0.450], [0.400, 0.300, 0.235, 0.450], [0.730, 0.300, 0.235, 0.450], ] axes = [fig.add_axes(position) for position in positions]
fig.text( 0.5, 0.955, "One signal, two physical patterns", ha="center", va="top", fontsize=15, fontweight="medium", )
def draw_stems(ax, values, color): markerline, stemlines, baseline = ax.stem( n, values, bottom=0, basefmt=" ", linefmt="-", markerfmt="o" ) plt.setp(stemlines, color=color, linewidth=2.0, zorder=3) plt.setp( markerline, color=color, markerfacecolor=color, markeredgecolor="white", markeredgewidth=0.8, markersize=7.5, zorder=4, ) ax.axhline(0, color=SLATE, linewidth=0.8, alpha=0.65, zorder=0) ax.set_xlim(-0.35, 3.35) ax.set_ylim(-2.5, 5) ax.set_yticks([-2, 0, 2, 4, 5]) ax.set_xticks(n) ax.set_xlabel(r"Sample index $n$", labelpad=6) ax.tick_params(axis="both", labelsize=9, length=3, pad=4) ax.spines["left"].set_bounds(-2, 5) ax.spines["bottom"].set_bounds(0, 3)
draw_stems(axes[0], x, INK) draw_stems(axes[1], 2 * u0, BLUE) draw_stems(axes[2], 2 * u1, TEAL)
axes[0].set_ylabel("Amplitude", labelpad=8) axes[0].set_title( "Measured signal\n" + r"$\mathbf{x}=[4,\,2,\,0,\,2]^{\mathsf{T}}$", fontsize=11, linespacing=1.6, pad=13, color=INK, ) axes[1].set_title( r"Uniform level: $2\mathbf{u}_0$" + "\n" + r"$\mathbf{u}_0=[1,\,1,\,1,\,1]^{\mathsf{T}}$", fontsize=11, linespacing=1.6, pad=13, color=BLUE, ) axes[2].set_title( r"Oscillation: $2\mathbf{u}_1$" + "\n" + r"$\mathbf{u}_1=[1,\,0,\,-1,\,0]^{\mathsf{T}}$", fontsize=11, linespacing=1.6, pad=13, color=TEAL, )
axes[1].axhline( 2, color=BLUE, linestyle=(0, (4, 3)), linewidth=1.1, alpha=0.65, zorder=1, )
n_dense = np.linspace(0, 3, 401) axes[2].plot( n_dense, 2 * np.cos(np.pi * n_dense / 2), color=TEAL, linestyle=(0, (1.2, 2.1)), linewidth=1.6, zorder=2, label=r"$2\cos(\pi n/2)$", ) axes[2].legend( loc="upper right", frameon=False, fontsize=9, handlelength=2.2, borderaxespad=0.4, )
fig.text(0.3525, 0.515, "=", ha="center", va="center", fontsize=27, color=INK) fig.text(0.6825, 0.515, "+", ha="center", va="center", fontsize=27, color=INK)
fig.text( 0.5, 0.135, r"Standard basis: 3 separate impulses at $n=0,\,1,\,3$.", ha="center", va="center", fontsize=10.5, ) fig.text( 0.5, 0.065, r"Physical patterns: constant background ($c_0=2$)" r" + oscillation amplitude ($c_1=2$).", ha="center", va="center", fontsize=10.5, )
